## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      11 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 7 jul 2026 - 27 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Rachel C_, 27 sept 2026, 1/5: "I've used Forest for years as a pro member, but the recent UI updates have made it almost unusable. I've gone from using forest every day to barely opening the app, and unless the developers listen to consumer feedback and go back to the way things were, I'll be uninstalling the app. Such a shame, a great app completely ruined!"
            2. _pay in app_, 26 sept 2026, 1/5: "It used to be useful, fun and clean. Not it’s slow, buggy & has so many annoying options that are distracting that it completely beats the purpose. I just deleted it after years of use."
            3. _A_Ruiz_, 19 sept 2026, 1/5: "After updating to version 5.26.0 the app tells me I have to log in, but I’m not fully logged out either and there’s no way to log out. So I’m blocked without being able to plant together, choose my app allow list or see the daily challenges. I’m very disappointed with how the company is dealing with the app lately. Every time you roll out a new version of the app it comes out incredibly glitchy. I really wished I had left it as it was, use the trees I already have and forget about the new events and stuff"
<!--/ir-theme-->
